## Branch flow

- [ ] Source and target follow feature -> dev -> preview -> main
- [ ] Promotion PRs (dev -> preview, preview -> main) will be merged with a merge commit, not squash

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (astro check, tests, build)
- [ ] UI changes checked on mobile and desktop; Vercel preview URL or screenshots below

## Contribution rules

- [ ] No code was deleted, or every deletion is listed below for approval
- [ ] Comments are written by the contributor in their own words
- [ ] Repeated markup or logic was turned into a component, layout or function
